reason: I have one or two chairs and I cut most of the hair myself, so I already know who is in which chair and what is in the drawer. ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month is real money for me, and WhatsApp already does bookings and reminders for free.
objection: Five thousand up front and a thousand every month for a shop this small, and I'm not sure where my customer numbers go. If the app company shuts down or I stop paying, do I lose everything, same as if my phone breaks?
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around ₹299-399 a month, plus a clear backup where I can download my full customer list to my own phone any time, even if I stop paying.
